claims.text: Unitree priced at ¥150.80/share on August 6, raising $904M at a $9.04B valuation — 45% above the market's earlier ~¥104/share consensus
Unitree's offer priced at 219.23x trailing statutory earnings, or 103x if a smaller, non-recurring-items-adjusted profit figure is used instead
The pre-clawback online multiple was ~8,289x; a later, larger post-clawback online allotment implies ~5,526x; the offline institutional tranche ... cleared at a much lower ~2,992x
The August 19 debut opened +629% and closed +460%
roughly ¥445bn (~$66bn) at the intraday peak, settling to roughly ¥342bn (~$50bn) at the close

on July 27, 2026 ... memory-chip maker CXMT closed its own STAR Market debut up 465.82%, briefly the most valuable company listed in mainland China at nearly $490bn, on a float of just 6.73% of post-IPO shares
FY2025 revenue reached ¥1.708bn, up 335% from ¥392.77M in 2024 and ¥159.13M in 2023
statutory net profit attributable to the parent was ¥278.21M (a 16.4% net margin), while profit after excluding non-recurring items was ¥590.75-600.1M
The gap is driven almost entirely by a roughly ¥349M non-cash share-based compensation charge booked to administrative expenses
Q1 2026 revenue grew 68.49% year-on-year to ¥423M ... net profit attributable to the parent fell 47.69% to 52.55% year-on-year
Founder and CEO Wang Xingxing holds 23.8% of Unitree's equity directly, but controls roughly 68.78% of the company's voting rights

DeepSeek's parent entity ... took a direct equity stake of roughly 2.31% (933,399-933,400 shares, ~¥141M, ~$21.3M) with a three-year lock-up ... DeepSeek's first disclosed equity position in a robotics company
AgiBot (Zhiyuan Robotics) overtook it, shipping roughly 8,400 units for a 44% global share against Unitree's roughly 5,900 units and 31% share over the same January-June window
Unitree announced cumulative production of roughly 18,000 bipedal humanoid robots to date ... a category cut that puts it well ahead of AgiBot's roughly 7,000 pure-bipedal units

The FCC's Public Notice DA 26-786 ... added 'foreign-produced advanced robotic devices' — a category defined by place of manufacture, not a named company — to the agency's Covered List, which blocks new equipment authorization for covered devices

the Department of Defense added Hangzhou Yushu Technology ... to the Section 1260H list on June 8, 2026, citing indirect SASAC affiliation ... it does not itself prohibit sales or purchases by private buyers, universities, or businesses

Xiaomi won a preliminary injunction and delisting in 2021; Luokung Technology's designation was voluntarily withdrawn by the DoD that same year; and in August 2026 a U.S. judge blocked the Pentagon's 1260H label for WuXi AppTec
U.S. sales fell from 18.39% of revenue in 2023 to 19.54% in 2024 and down to 13.3% in 2025
the top five customers were just 10.61% of 9-month-2025 revenue, with JD.com the single largest buyer at 3.54%
the fund itself has traded at a large and persistent premium to its own disclosed net asset value (roughly 168% over NAV as of August 6, 2026: $28.19/share against a $10.51 NAV)
Wang Xingxing said a robotics 'ChatGPT moment' ... is likely two to ten years away
His own paper wealth from the listing — roughly $16bn, on his 23.8% direct stake
Xiaomi has so far shown only a CyberOne V2 prototype with no disclosed price, sale date, or unit target — a materially earlier stage than BYD's
RoboStrategy ... disclosed this directly: RoboStrategy 'holds positions in competitors Figure AI and Apptronik'
only about 10% of 2025 global humanoid production reached any real-world deployment, with the deployments that did occur 'predominantly driven by government subsidies... not commercial rationale'
